releases.notes:
# orion_robot-1.0.0

![orion_view](https://github.com/DFD-Workshop/orion_robot_mod/blob/main/docs/media/orion_view.png)

First official and stable release for the ORION robot mod, which add the [DFD Workshop](https://github.com/DFD-Workshop) robot as your companion in MC. It add the ORION mob, which can be only spawned by its egg and can be tamed with iron ingots (90%). Its behavior is set follow you, attack a little (just half a heart and retreat) and avoid water.  

To know more about ORION robot, you can explore [orion_common](https://github.com/DanielFLopez1620/orion_common)
